image_processing: Original crops pasted onto neutral sheet, with simple arrows/labels only. Some crops resized uniformly and labelled; no reconstruction or body edits.

front.caution: Combined silhouette is not the hidden windshield cowl boundary. White front wing occlusion and slight camera yaw prevent direct single-pane width inference.

overhead_station_x350.relationships: Roof width about 48% of body; full outboard side-glass silhouette about 84% of body. Central black pane retains front-wide/rear-narrow plan taper.

rear_three_quarter.caution: Apparent diagonal lower edge is a 3D perspective projection, not an instruction to slope the beltline by this image angle.

baseline_geometry.side_window_end: All u end at z=0.945, leaving finite-height rear edge; white rear buttress starts there.
baseline_geometry.interpretation: Already has about 34 degrees of transverse outboard slope at cabin peak. Strong evidence supports distinct angular rear window termination and broader triangular white C-buttress. Evidence alone does not establish an exact new transverse angle.
